about_the_game:
Inside My Mind is a single-player, first-person psychological horror game. You awaken in an abandoned and eerie hospital, with no memory of how you arrived. The only thing you hear when you open your eyes is silence; distant, indistinct noises and the echo of footsteps accompany you as you move.

As you progress through the cold and dark corridors, you will discover mysterious notes and documents in various rooms of the hospital. These clues help you piece together who you are, why you are here, and the hospital’s dark past. Along the way, you will encounter locked doors, puzzles that must be solved, and unsettling events that will keep you on edge.

Your goal is to uncover the truth behind your past and the secrets of the hospital, and to reach a final conclusion. Combining atmospheric exploration, puzzle-solving, and tension-filled moments, Inside My Mind offers players an intense horror experience lasting approximately 1–2 hours.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes disturbing scenes and psychological horror throughout the entire experience. Players will encounter blood stains, body bags, autopsy rooms, and unsettling sounds. These are present from the beginning and do not require any unlocking.
